scheme_name: Tripura Lynching/Mob Violence Victim Compensation Scheme
other_conditions: Must be a resident of Tripura.
Must have suffered loss or injury due to lynching/mob violence and require rehabilitation.
Compensation eligibility requires a court order.
Victim must report the crime to the Officer‑in‑Charge of the local Police Station or the Judicial Magistrate before claiming compensation.
Victim or claimant must cooperate with police and prosecution; hostility or refusal to testify disqualifies the claim.
The death or permanent incapacitation must not be due to the victim’s wrongdoing or substantial provocation.
Victim must have substantial loss of income or be unable to afford medical treatment expenses.
In case of death, dependents may claim compensation only if the family is destitute with no earning member.
Perpetrators of the crime and their dependents are ineligible for compensation.
benefits_summary: Provides compensation up to ₹4 Lakhs for death, ₹2 Lakhs for permanent disability, and scaled amounts for property loss and medical expenses, with a maximum of ₹1 Lakh for emergency medical aid.
documents_required: Copy of the charge sheet/final report of the investigating officer
